content.text: The ticket (t002, bug, normal priority) reports that pasting a Google Sheets table into a note on Lumen web with Chrome 131 collapses the columns into one long line, and that it worked the previous week. Searches for Google Sheets/table paste issues and for Chrome 131 found no other tickets describing this problem or any recent change affecting it. The only related-sounding ticket, t058, describes a different symptom (blank notebooks and session expiry), so I found no known issue that explains this one.
